description: Merge a duplicate contact INTO another one: its entries, tasks, notes, day blocks, companies and tags (pages) move to the target (no duplicates), the target's empty details (email, phone, job title, address, birthday) are filled from it, its notes are appended to the target's, @mentions of its name are rewritten to the target's name, then it is deleted. Use it when two records describe the same person (e.g. two 'Pascale Villières'). Two people can share a name: confirm with your user that it is the same person, and which record to keep.

source_id.description: UUID of the contact to merge away (it will be deleted)

target_id.description: UUID of the contact to keep

name: merge_contacts
